verdict.rationale: Elastic's own docs say developers can run ad-hoc queries on telemetry with ES|QL, query metrics with ES|QL or PromQL, and use custom KQL queries, so the core story is directly covered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of ES|QL ad-hoc analysis, and an in-depth language reference in the evidence (the pack has overview-level mentions only).

support.subject: As a developer, I can analyze telemetry ad hoc with a documented query language

citations.quote: This enables quick searching, ad-hoc queries with ES|QL, and visualization with prebuilt dashboards to diagnose issues.
Query them with ES|QL or Prometheus Query Language (PromQL), visualize them
ES|QL delivers sub-second responses on millions of time series metrics
